scope: All canonical English /guide/ pages in the live sitemap; translated duplicates and linked third-party sites excluded
method: Direct HTTPS fetch of every canonical page; read extracted main-article text, including configuration/CLI examples and integration/development/privacy/community pages. Original HTML/text cached temporarily; repository retains hashes, source links and LAZERS decisions.

pages.title: Getting Started with Repomix ​
pages.lazersDecision: Adopt reusable repository context, but serve selected material rather than requiring the entire repository in every prompt.

pages.title: Agent Skills Generation ​
pages.lazersDecision: Use small descriptors and on-demand versioned references for approved library knowledge; do not auto-install generated instructions as required skills.

pages.title: Claude Code Plugins ​
pages.lazersDecision: Adopt progressive exploration patterns; no Claude-specific plugin, extra CLI launch or second MCP service in LAZERS.

pages.title: Code Compression ​
pages.lazersDecision: Use structural outlines for navigation and interfaces; retrieve original implementation/tests for behavior and edits.

pages.title: Command Line Options ​
pages.lazersDecision: Map filtering/token/output controls to validated library policy. Token-budget failure is post-generation and cannot bound input work.

pages.title: Comment Removal ​
pages.lazersDecision: Keep domain contracts and rationale by default. Optional removal must earn savings without increasing mistakes.

pages.title: Community Projects ​
pages.lazersDecision: Surveyed all listed integration categories; no additional editor/desktop wrapper or alternate language implementation is required.

pages.title: Configuration ​
pages.lazersDecision: Use plugin-owned config, ignores and first-match full/compressed/structure-only recipes. Disable history sorting and external processors.

pages.title: Custom Instructions ​
pages.lazersDecision: Assemble repository rules and native skills once through ContextPacket; avoid duplicate instruction payloads in every packed file.

pages.title: Contributing to Repomix ​
pages.lazersDecision: Verify actual exported package behavior and upgrade compatibility. Repomix's own lint/build stack does not replace LAZERS tooling.

pages.title: Using Repomix as a Library ​
pages.lazersDecision: Pinned public core exports, lazy server loading and initialized token counter; compression requires actual parser/WASM packaging verification.

pages.title: FAQ and Troubleshooting ​
pages.lazersDecision: Prefer targeted context and incremental retrieval for large/private repositories; secret scans do not replace access checks or evidence review.

pages.title: Using Repomix with GitHub Actions ​
pages.lazersDecision: Optional future revision-bound reference artifacts; pin tool/action versions. Producing an artifact does not prove task acceptance.

pages.title: Installation ​
pages.lazersDecision: Pin library dependency and test Bun compatibility; no global CLI, browser extension, container or extra editor dependency required.

pages.title: MCP Server ​
pages.lazersDecision: Adopt opaque artifact identities, bounded search/range reads and local confinement through native plugin tools rather than an added server.

pages.title: Output Formats ​
pages.lazersDecision: Structured JSON metadata for programs; source/Markdown for focused human/model evidence. Benchmark optional XML instead of declaring a universal best format.

pages.title: Privacy Policy ​
pages.lazersDecision: Local packing; no hosted code upload. Selected context still reaches the authorized inference provider and is not made private merely by packing.

pages.title: Prompt Examples ​
pages.lazersDecision: Use bounded task-specific questions and evidence formats. Broad review templates are not mandatory process for every request.

pages.title: GitHub Repository Processing ​
pages.lazersDecision: Later approved, revision-pinned library/doc references; leave remote config trust off and avoid ambiguous remote/local path inputs.

pages.title: Repomix Explorer Skill (Agent Skills) ​
pages.lazersDecision: Adopt search-before-reading/progressive disclosure mechanically. Do not add a CLI-oriented skill merely to tell models to repeat commands.

pages.title: Security ​
pages.lazersDecision: Keep Secretlint, but enforce path/read/ignore boundaries separately. Do not execute project/global configs or allow external instruction reads.

pages.title: Sponsors 💖 ​
pages.lazersDecision: Reviewed support/funding page; no product dependency or runtime behavior derived.

pages.title: AI-Assisted Development Best Practices: From My Experience ​
pages.lazersDecision: Use existing implementation/test examples and complete a coherent feature before expanding. Treat file-size heuristics as guidance, not new policy.

pages.title: Basic Usage ​
pages.lazersDecision: Filter by task-relevant code/tests, inspect token weights, and select output level. Splitting all content across files does not reduce total input.

pages.title: Use Cases ​
pages.lazersDecision: Prioritize implementation planning, bug investigation and approved dependency/reference research. Measure real completion rather than assume whole-repo context always wins.

pages.title: Watch Mode ​
pages.lazersDecision: On-demand reuse first. Future debounced invalidation may help; automatic full repacking on every edit is not assumed economical.
